prompt:
Platform-automation ticket. We are standardizing on VCF Automation 9.1, the successor to vRealize Automation and Aria Automation, and need a tiny dependency-free Java client for project bootstrap. Implement the entire production client in one sibling file, `VcfAutomationClient.java` (plain JDK only). `TestMain.java` is the acceptance harness and runs with `java TestMain.java`.

Research first, before changing code: use genuine web search/fetch against the current official Broadcom developer portal and read the VCF Automation 9.1 xAPIs reference pages for `Get All Projects`, `Create`, and their authentication. VCF Automation is not covered by a published specification in `vmware/vcf-api-specs`; this repository therefore pins a reference-derived contract in `docs/contract.json` and records its official page provenance in `docs/official_sources.json`. Both are protected. Compare the live reference with those fixtures. If the live pages disagree, report the conflict in your final summary and do not edit the fixtures or tests. Cite the exact official Broadcom URLs you read.

The client surface is:
- `new VcfAutomationClient(String baseUrl, String authorization)`. The authorization argument is the complete value for the documented `Authorization` header. Send it on every API request; never place it in a URL or exception message.
- nested `record Project(String id, String name, String description)`.
- `List<Project> listProjects()`: call the pinned VCF Automation project collection operation and return every item sorted lexicographically by `name`, then `id`. Sorting is a client guarantee; do not trust response order.
- `Project ensureProject(String name, String description)`: provide retry-safe create semantics using only the two operations named in the pinned contract. First list and return an exact-name match without mutating it. If absent, create the project with the documented JSON shape and return the `201` project. A documented `409` can mean another retry/actor created the same name after the read; reconcile it with one fresh list and return the exact-name match, otherwise raise the API error. Calling `ensureProject` again after success must not create another project.
- nested `ApiException extends RuntimeException` exposing `statusCode()` for non-success responses. Its message must not contain the authorization value.

Use the pinned `apiVersion`, paging inputs, headers, and response fields in `docs/contract.json`. Do not add SDKs, Maven, or extra production files.

Acceptance: `java TestMain.java`. It starts a contract-pinned loopback mock only; no live VMware endpoint or credential is contacted. The mock exposes only the operations named by the protected contract, alternates project element order on every collection response, and keeps a request log the harness inspects. `TestMain.java` and everything under `docs/` are protected; do not modify them.

Authorization header authentication shared by the named project operations
